Let $V$ be a vector space over $\mathbb{F}$.

If:

{{#content:Q2002}}

== Intersection and union ==

For vector subspaces $F,G$ $\in V$

$$
\vec u \in F \cap G \iff \vec u \in F \land \vec u \in G \text{  intersection}\\
\vec u \in F \cup G \iff \vec u \in F \lor \vec u \in G \text{  union}
$$

== Sum ==

For vector subspaces $F,G$ $\in V$

$$
F+G = \{\vec u + \vec v |\vec u \in F, \vec v \in G \}
$$

=== Property ===

$$
\dim(F+G)=\dim(F)+\dim(G)-\dim(F \cap G)
$$

== Composition ==

$$
\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_n\} = \operatorname{span}\{u_1\} + \cdots + \operatorname{span}\{u_n\}
$$

for $U=\{u_1,\cdots, u_n\} \in V$.

== Supplementary subspaces ==

For vector subspaces $F,G$ $\in V$, if

* $F+G=E$, and
* $F \cap G = \{ \vec 0_V \}$

Then $F,G$ are '''supplementary vector subspaces''' of $V$, noted as $E=F \oplus G$
